{
  "plan": ["Identificar los proveedores con mayor monto adjudicado", "Filtrar proveedores que ganaron al menos 50 adjudicaciones", "Seleccionar los 5 proveedores con mayor monto adjudicado"],
  "action": "final_sql",
  "sql": "WITH top_suppliers AS (
  SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, SUM(a.amount_usd) AS total_awarded_usd
  FROM awards a
  JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = a.supplier_id
  GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
  HAVING COUNT(a.award_id) >= 50
)
SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, total_awarded_usd
FROM top_suppliers
ORDER BY total_awarded_usd DESC
LIMIT 5;"
}
